headline: AFRY Reports Margin Expansion in Q3 as Organic Revenue Decline Slows
summary: Engineering and design firm AFRY reported expanded profit margins in its third-quarter results as its organic sales decline narrowed.
why: AFRY is an international engineering, design, and advisory company providing infrastructure and industrial solutions across Europe.

impacts.name: AFRY AB
impacts.why: Improving operational profitability and moderating revenue headwinds support margin outlook.
